title: Spellwork
tagline: Spend soul gems for skill points, train magicka alone. Skyrimnet triggers added
description: Train in magicka schools solo, no trainer and no practice partner. Soul Study spends a soul to raise a school one level, like a trainer. Practice Ward conjures a dummy: spells cast near it teach half as much as it would in live combat. Degrades over time (you get tired training - this is flavor roleplay, not tracked, no buffs or debuffs)
author: whyregister
